{{Item|title=Spheres / Degrees of the AOE|image=Five-Transcendental-radiation.png|imagecaption=}}The AOE structure and belief system follows a tiered structure, often symbolised as Concentric rings or radiations: ·, (·), ((·)), (((·))), and ((((·)))).  

Each sphere has an increasing amount of radiations, each radiation denoting a specific cosmic sphere or time dimension. The spheres act as both an armour and an albi for each radiations above it, reaching all the way to the central Point of Origin. Each superior radiation acts as a puppet-master to the inferior radiations.  

As initiates move closer to the Point of Origin the level of secrecy increases, the notation of the radiations is used to classify  levels of secrecy and to designate the hierarchy of time. it is well know among inmates that an action of a higher radiation is incomprehensible to any below it.
